description: Put 2 or 3 listings side by side, as the site's /compare page does. For each listing: the facts that set it apart from the others ("Only one with a CLI", "No auth required", "Most skills (12)"). Then one row per field, with each listing's value by slug: what it is, provider, official vendor, verified, access, auth, MCP server, CLI install, API base URL, skills, streaming, push, categories, tags, listed since. A row where every listing agrees has same: true. Facts from the listings' own data, never a verdict. A curated comparison of the same listings adds its intro line. Unknown or repeated slugs, and any past 3, are left out with a note.

slugs.description: Listing slugs to compare, in column order: 2 or 3, e.g. ["deepgram", "assemblyai"]

name: compare_agents

featured.description: Featured: set only by the maintainer. With no search text, results list featured listings first, then A→Z; with search text, results are ranked by relevance and equal scores keep that featured-first order.

iconUrl.description: Absolute URL of the listing's 128px PNG icon, served by Agent Switchboard; null when it has none

official.description: Official: a first-party listing, published by the company behind the product under its own domain or GitHub org (e.g. Notion's own Notion MCP, not a community build), where that company is a major vendor (publicly traded, a frontier AI lab, or valued around $1B+). It records who publishes the product, not a paid placement, and is separate from Verified.

verified.description: Verified: we checked it works — its URLs load and its declared access (API, MCP, CLI or extension) responds. Re-checked monthly; the label drops if it stops working.

intro.description: A curated comparison's editorial line; null for any other mix

notes.description: Named listings that were left out, and why

same.description: Every listing has the same value

anyOf.description: A command or address from the listing's docs, with what it is

title: Compare Agents
